The admissible window moved instead: niter 2 -> 3 lowers the structural floor (1-a)^k(R-1)/R from 3.7318% to 2.1698%, so the same tolerance went from 6/48 realized exceedances to 0/48. This is the opposite of raising a tolerance to make a check pass.

measurement.why_niter3: At 48 seeds the two arms have essentially equal spread (sd ratio 1.036), so the advantage is entirely the 1.61 pp lower mean. niter=2's max sits 0.1428 pp below the immovable ceiling C AND grew +0.2291 pp going 16->48 seeds; niter=3's max did not move at all over the same expansion and sits 1.2441 pp below C. Realized exceedance of 0.05 is 6/48 vs 0/48 (Fisher exact p ~ 0.026, so the arms differ without any gaussian assumption).
measurement.corrected_earlier_claim: A 2026-08-05 19:25Z reading that the niter=3 sd 'grew 56%' was a small-sample artifact of differencing two 16-seed variance estimates: F=2.4498 on df (15,15), two-sided p=0.093, 95% CI for the sd ratio [0.925, 2.648], which contains 1.0 and contains the eventual 48-seed value 1.036. That reading briefly inverted the recommendation toward raising the tolerance to 0.055; it was not significant.
measurement.independent_review: agy (separate provider account, effort high) reproduced the F-test and interval, verified the operating point and both arms against the repo, and endorsed niter=3 + tol 0.05 on statistics, physics and tolerance governance.

code_fixes_in_this_reissue.item3_repaired_a_test_that_had_gone_VACU: test_b1_normalization_fix.py::test_tolerance_has_power_against_the_defect_and_admits_the_floor hardcoded the recoil-era operating point (R,acc,k = 1.135, 0.621, 2) and bounded the tolerance above by the defect signal (R-1)/R. It PASSED while proving nothing: 0.621 is the recoil-only acceptance (full-event FPS expands the truth denominator 32.8M -> 49.2M, so a=0.4186 and the floor more than doubles), and the real upper bound is the parameter-free ceiling C=(R-1)/(2R)=(R-1)/R / 2, so bounding by the defect signal admitted a whole range of INERT tolerances. It now reads R and the acceptance from the tracked Gate-2 receipt and niter from FROZEN, asserts the soundness condition 2(1-a)^k < 1, and pairs every PASS with a must-FAIL mutation.
